//: Network-integration manifest for gateway-model-agent. Describes how this agent is wired
//flows: into the enterprise network flows. Aggregated by the deploy-agent-network workflow.
//exposeToM365: false: this agent is NOT published to Microsoft Teams / M365, so YARP does NOT wire a /teams/<agentName> edge route for it and the Teams publish job is skipped.
//exposeFoundryApi: true: reachable through the governed Foundry Responses API. YARP wires the shared /<account>/<project> edge route to the foundry-agents APIM API (token limits below apply).
//tokenLimits: DENY-BY-DEFAULT allowlist for the governed foundry-agents Responses API. Only the callers listed here may invoke this agent; everyone else gets 403. agentRef defaults to the folder name; use "*" for any agent. Each principal is keyed by email (interactive user), appId (web/daemon), or BOTH (OBO, AND-matched). tokensPerMinute is required; tokenQuota + tokenQuotaPeriod are optional.
